programs.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters
programs.desc: Trace dazzling waterways all over the world, from volcanic rivers in Russia’s far east to geothermal streams in Florida. Watch as beavers transform entire landscapes with their well-engineered dams, then enjoy a winter spa day with manatees.

director: Andrew Zikking: Executive Producer, Laura Coates: Series Producer

programs.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters
programs.desc: Journey through mystical lakes, where life adapts, survives, and transforms. Witness the power of ancient beasts like the snapping turtle, watch a dragonfly metamorphosis, and walk tall with flamingoes as they brave burning, corrosive waters.

director: Andrew Zikking: Executive Producer, Laura Coates: Series Producer

programs.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters
programs.desc: Unmask the eerie beauty of swamplands, which have inspired centuries of folklore and serve as a vital link between life and death. Swim with hungry crocodiles, see deer gamble with their lives for food, and watch carnivorous plants snap up prey.

director: Andrew Zikking: Executive Producer, Laura Coates: Series Producer

programs.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters
programs.desc: Freeze time as water becomes a force of change in Earth’s most frigid ecosystems. Hunt for unsuspecting seals with polar bears, bathe in natural hot springs with macaques, and try out a unique survival strategy with Arctic foxes.

director: Andrew Zikking: Executive Producer, Laura Coates: Series Producer

programs.title: Volcanic Odysseys
programs.desc: The Danakil Depression in Ethiopia is not only one of the most inhospitable places on Earth, but is one of the most geologically active. Now, volcanologist Tom Pfeiffer is taking a group of adventure tourists to cross the Danakil to see the Erte Ale volcano.

programs.title: The Kimberley: Australia's Wild West
programs.desc: Avoid scaly and feathery dangers with wallabies, see koolamana lizards battle for mates, and feast with crocodile hatchlings. Brave dangerous rapids and understand the cultural and biological importance of a local river as the rainy season arrives.

director: Nick Robinson: Director, Mark Coles Smith: Narrator

programs.title: The Kimberley: Australia's Wild West
programs.desc: Battle for dominion over the river with crocs, then catch glimpses of an ultra-rare mangrove snake and an endangered nabarlek wallaby. Take to the ocean to see humpback whale mothers raise their calves, then be hunted by false killer whales.

director: Nick Robinson: Director, Mark Coles Smith: Narrator

programs.title: My Best Friend's An Animal
programs.desc: Walk on the wild side with Sirga the lion, whose human pal, Val, has been by her side since she was an orphaned cub. See Loki the raven entertain his BFF Elliott, cuddle with Hugger the stingray, and see why Trish and Garri the koala are like family.

director: Kait Borsay: Narrator, Kirstie McLure: Executive Producer

programs.title: Pride Rules
programs.desc: Contend with the challenges of the rainy season, which turns everything green and spoils the lions’ camouflage. Watch Einstein fail to make new connections and weigh the pros and cons when Keeza and her cub are kidnapped by rival male Mad-Eye Moody.

director: Peter Lamberti: Executive Producer, Ivanno Jeremiah: Narrator

programs.title: Pride Rules
programs.desc: Say hello to a season of plenty as flood waters recede and vast herds of prey return to the Chobe’s banks. Watch Keeza and her cub make a break for it while Caller and Tom Tom brawl with their enemies, then cheer when Einstein finally finds a mate.

director: Peter Lamberti: Executive Producer, Ivanno Jeremiah: Narrator

programs.title: Africa's Hunters
programs.desc: Enter the heart of Zambia’s Luangwa Valley, where shady woodlands and antelope-packed plains offer the perfect hunting grounds for an audacious female leopard named Olimba and the pack she must struggle to control.

programs.title: The Living Beach
programs.desc: The beaches of California are some of the most beautiful in the world, but are they falling out of balance due to mankind’s effects on nature? What does it take for the magnificent fauna of the Pacific Coast to keep living… on the “living beach”.
